CFF table and Type 2 charstring outline decoder.

Parses the CFF table (header, INDEX structures, Top DICT, Private DICTs, FDSelect/FDArray for CID-keyed fonts) and executes Type 2 charstrings into draw ops. Operator semantics follow Adobe TN 5177; arg patterns for the hv/vh/hh/vv curve ops cross-checked against the OT spec CFF2 charstring chapter (same encoding as Type 2).

Any inconsistency inside the table or a charstring makes the decode return none / false rather than raising. CFF2 tables (major == 2) are unsupported and report no outline (TODO). The deprecated Type 2 seac form (endchar with adx ady bchar achar, TN 5177 Appendix C) is supported via the Standard Encoding and the font charset; nested seac is rejected per spec.
